target_depth: Conceptual definitions, mathematical derivation, convergence assumptions, algorithm behaviour, and implementation.
proof_depth: explain reasoning and assumptions without requiring a fully formal proof
learning_goals: Explain the dominant eigenpair of a real symmetric matrix
State convergence assumptions and asymptotic rate
Use the Rayleigh quotient and residual
Explain failure cases and non-symmetric limitations
Distinguish largest magnitude from largest algebraic eigenvalue
assumptions_requiring_review: Do not assume prior knowledge of iterative eigensolvers.
Disciplinary contexts are bounded pedagogical framing rather than unsupported physical claims.
